authority.source_authority: The DAD repository and explicit human gates retain source and execution authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only bounded-mcp-writer repairs the five MCP findings; independent-mcp-checker remains read-only and performs the return review.

roles.why_needed: One writer must repair the independently confirmed enforcement gaps without overlapping the checker.
roles.mission: Repair validation behavior binding, full MCP CLI route inventory, exact timestamp boundaries, JSON-RPC error privacy, and all navigation consumers, then refresh fingerprints.
inputs: current MCP source and host adapter bundle
roles.authority: May edit only MCP-related source, schemas, registries, assets, navigation, validation, tests, and documentation; no live host configuration.
acceptance_conditions: All five negative probes fail closed.
Focused MCP suites, repository validation, Ruff, and diff checks pass.
stop_conditions: A live host configuration write is required.

readiness_conditions: Exact fingerprints are refreshed only after code and tests stabilize.

roles.why_needed: The original checker found five false-current and privacy gaps and must verify their repair independently.
roles.mission: Re-run adversarial probes for validation stubbing, hidden MCP routes, time boundaries, error leakage, and missing navigation consumers, then issue a separate release gate.
roles.authority: Read-only return review; cannot edit writer outputs, accept its own changes, or grant execution authority.
acceptance_conditions: Each prior finding has independent closure evidence or remains open.
Writer/checker separation and no-authority boundary remain intact.
stop_conditions: A finding lacks raw reproducible evidence.

readiness_conditions: All writer evidence and both mesh revisions are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove the map cannot claim current when enforcement, routes, navigation, time, privacy, or authority drift.

reconciliations.reason: The writer boundary remains valid, but five independent findings materially narrow and strengthen its mission and acceptance evidence.
The checker stays separate, while its mission changes from broad audit to explicit closure of the five confirmed findings.
evidence_refs: confirmed validation, route, time, error-privacy, and navigation findings
